record word 3: high halfword of the size word (the else path loads the surface buffer's +0x1c/+0x1e pair the same way)
record word 4: low halfword of the size word
record word 5: (pitch & 0xff0) << 0x12 goes into the offset/pitch word, like (+0x840 & 0x3fc0) << 0x10 on the surface path
GART address >> 10 | pitch bits, stored as record word 6
the surface's buffer record whose +0x1c size word is copied on the surface path (0 on the transfer-buffer path)
buffer +0x560: the base address of the frame buffer (the same name the 0x0a handler uses)
secondBufferInfo + 0x560, the base address of the buffer named by record word 2
fieldHeight * pitch: bytes of one luma field
base + 1.5 * fieldBytes: the end of a 4:2:0 frame (luma plus two quarter-size chroma planes)
record word 6: puVar26 = recordCursor + this, where the first register block is written
record word 8: the second register block's GART address is the first's plus this * 4
record word 9: selects destBufferInfo = surface + index * 0x78
the running GART address of the data blocks, advanced by blockStride
the byte distance between consecutive blocks, derived from the overlay width and height
the second transfer buffer's GART address, advanced by gartStep * 4 for the second register block
surface +0x8b8: buffers[17] +0x18 (buffer i has its pitch at +0xa8 + i*0x78 + 0x18)
tilingBit0 << 2 | (tilingByte0Shifted & 3) << 3, OR-ed into every texture offset
recordCursor + record word 6: the first register block
